designOrigin: Trial 29 development was observed before this freeze. It passed return, Sharpe, drawdown, activity, and realized-maintenance gates but failed the frozen 20% unilateral-gap stress gate. Trial 30 changes only collateral risk management: instead of waiting for a weekly calendar rebalance, it performs a causal proactive collateral equalization at an observed 8h boundary whenever either venue's post-PnL collateral would not retain a 10%-of-notional buffer above the frozen 20% shock plus 5% maintenance requirement. Trial 29 final remained sealed and no Trial 30 economic output was observed before freeze.
hypothesis: The Trial 29 static BTC/ETH long-Binance/short-Hyperliquid carry can retain at least 7% annualized net return while passing venue-isolated maintenance and 20% unilateral-gap stress if collateral is moved proactively only when the next-gap reserve becomes thin, rather than on a fixed weekly calendar.

finalHoldout.accessRule: Final market rows and economics may be observed only after every frozen development gate passes.

strategy.direction: always long Binance perpetual and short equal-coin Hyperliquid perpetual
strategy.proactiveCollateralTriggerRule: After realized price and funding PnL at each 8h boundary, first fail any actual 5% maintenance breach. Then compute each venue balance minus the capital required for a 20% adverse unilateral gap plus 5% maintenance. If either remaining excess is below 10% of that leg's current notional, equalize total sleeve capital back to 45% Binance / 45% Hyperliquid / 10% cash, paying the frozen transfer cost, before applying the hypothetical 20% stress test.
strategy.riskOrdering: Book realized PnL; check actual maintenance; if proactive buffer trigger is hit, transfer collateral; then test frozen 20% unilateral gap stress; then if either leg notional exceeds 150% of current sleeve equity, close/reopen both legs at 75% with full execution costs.

fundingClock.hyperliquid: Use raw Hyperliquid fundingHistory settlement/publication event time; sum records in (previous 8h boundary,current boundary], do not backdate or interpolate.
fundingClock.causality: Only actually settled funding cash is booked.

costModel.application: 15 bps per venue leg per open/close/re-anchor; 5 bps on gross collateral moved during proactive equalization.

marginModel.rule: Actual maintenance is tested before transfers. Hypothetical 20% unilateral gap stress is tested after any pre-committed proactive transfer at the same observed boundary, representing collateral positioned before the next unknown move.

antiRescueRule: After the first Trial 30 development economic output, no scientific parameter, asset, notional, stress buffer, collateral target, transfer cost, clock rule, or gate may change under Trial 30.
